description: This file defines the 'EffectedSubjects' interface in the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.enforcers', which models a collection of 'granted' and 'revoked' authorization subjects within a specific resource context. It emphasizes immutability and provides methods to retrieve the sets of authorized subjects.

classes.name: EffectedSubjects
classes.description: An interface representing a collection of granted and revoked authorization subjects within a certain resource scope, requiring immutability.

methods.name: getGranted
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of authorization subjects granted within the scope.

methods.name: getRevoked
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of authorization subjects revoked within the scope.
